q: Why do I need to be registered?
a: Registration allows Gondo Motors to verify your details, contact you about auctions or sales, and ensure a secure transaction process.
A deposit is an initial payment made to secure your interest in a vehicle or to participate in auction bidding. It is deducted from the final invoice.
The invoice is the official document showing the full cost of the vehicle, including any fees, shipping, and taxes. It serves as a receipt for payment.

q: Can I bid at Japanese car auctions by myself?
a: No, you need to use Gondo Motors’ professional assistance. We provide expertise and handle bidding on your behalf to ensure accuracy and compliance with auction rules.
Cancellation policies depend on the stage of the transaction. Please contact Gondo Motors immediately if you wish to cancel.

q: Why Year of Manufacture not identical with Year of Registration?
a: The year of manufacture indicates when the car was built, while the year of registration is when it was first registered in Japan. These years often differ.

q: Are there any guarantees for a vehicle?
a: Gondo Motors ensures vehicles are inspected and accurately described. However, international vehicles are usually sold "as-is," unless stated otherwise.
Delivery is carried out via shipping companies to your chosen destination port. Gondo Motors coordinates all logistics and documentation.

q: What should I do if the vehicle is damaged during transportation?
a: Immediately contact Gondo Motors. We work with shipping partners to assess damages and assist with claims if necessary.

q: What should I do if the vehicle is damaged during unload?
a: Contact Gondo Motors immediately. Our team will provide guidance and support for insurance or claims if needed.

q: Why is the cost and condition of Japanese cars better than in any other country?
a: Japanese vehicles are well-maintained, undergo regular inspections, and have transparent auction histories, making them cost-effective and reliable.

q: Is it possible to roll back the odometer on vehicle I'm buying?
a: Japanese auction cars are inspected thoroughly. Gondo Motors guarantees accurate mileage information; rolling back the odometer is illegal and extremely rare.

q: Can I buy a left handle drive car in Japan?
a: Yes, left-hand drive cars are available. Gondo Motors can source them according to your preference.
JEVIC (Japan Export Vehicle Inspection Center) and JAAI (Japan Auto Appraisal Institute) are third-party companies that inspect vehicles in Japan to ensure quality and authenticity.
